name: Noob Tycoon 🙂
desc:
Collect Tix from the noobs and throw them into the currency exchange! Use your money to buy more noobs and merge them together to make them more powerful! Compete with your friends to earn a spot on the leaderboards!

😋 Unlock wacky and powerful noobs!
🎫 Toss your Tix into the currency exchange for money!
💾 Tycoon progress automatically saves!
♻️ Noobs automatically merge at 208 noobs to prevent lag!

⭐ If you enjoyed the game, "Favorite" and "Follow" it to be the first to hear about new updates!

👍 Remember to like the game! A community reward will be unlocked at 30,000 likes!
